metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed GIMP theme from Dark to Light by navigating Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme and selecting Light, then clicking OK.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP preferences via Edit menu, navigate Interface > Theme section, select a theme from the list, and confirm with OK.
metadata.task_rationale: Same navigation pattern but targets 'System' theme, which is the last option in the theme list. Tests that the model can select different items from the same preference panel.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP theme to System via Preferences > Interface > Theme. Evaluator quits GIMP to flush gimprc, then checks config file for theme key set to System.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (gimp_config_file) correctly reads gimprc from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc, which is where GIMP stores theme settings.
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure config is flushed to disk before reading.
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses gimprc Lisp-style format by stripping parentheses and splitting by whitespace, then matching key='theme' and value='"System"'.
Expected parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns rules dict directly, and check_config_status accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] directly without incorrect nesting.
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement (set theme to System) is fully verified by checking the config file.
Minor cosmetic issue: rules dict has 'type:' (trailing colon) instead of 'type', but check_config_status never reads this field so it has no runtime impact.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix typo in rules: change 'type:' to 'type' (trailing colon) for consistency, though it does not affect evaluation logic.
